name: Emergency: call 911
when: Life-threatening emergencies: trouble breathing, chest pain, severe bleeding, unconsciousness, seizure, signs of stroke, overdose.

name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
when: Thoughts of suicide, a mental health crisis, or emotional distress. Free and confidential.

name: Poison Control
when: Swallowed, inhaled, or touched something that might be poisonous, or a medication mistake.

name: Lincoln University Public Safety
address: International Cultural Center, 1570 Baltimore Pike, Lincoln University, PA 19352
when: On-campus emergencies after hours and on weekends. Public Safety can arrange transport to care.

name: Lincoln University Health Services
hours: Mon 9 AM-8 PM; Tue-Fri 9 AM-5 PM; every other Sat 9 AM-2 PM
address: Wellness Center, Suite 100, 1570 Baltimore Pike, Lincoln University, PA 19352
when: Non-emergency care for Lincoln students: illness, vaccines, check-ups. Book online at lionshealth.lincoln.edu.

name: Lincoln University Counseling Services
address: Wellness Center, Suite 221, Lincoln University, PA 19352
when: Free, confidential mental health support for Lincoln students.

name: LCH Health Center, Oxford
when: Community health center in Oxford offering acute and primary care for families and individuals.

name: ChristianaCare Hospital, West Grove (ER)
address: 1015 W Baltimore Pike, West Grove, PA 19390 (former Jennersville Hospital, off US Route 1)
when: Nearest emergency room to Lincoln and Oxford. Treats falls, injuries, heart attacks, and strokes.

name: Chester County Hospital (ER)
address: 701 E Marshall St, West Chester, PA 19380
when: Full hospital with a large emergency department and an accredited chest pain center.

name: Chester County Health Department
address: 601 Westtown Rd, Suite 290, West Chester, PA 19380
when: Vaccines including MMR, measles questions, and exposure guidance. If you think you have measles, call them BEFORE going to a doctor. Disease investigation line: 610-344-6452.
